findings.description:
Reentrancy in RMTReclaimCampaignV1._pull(address,uint256) (reclaim/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV1.sol#97-101):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- _call(abi.encodeCall(IReclaimERC20.transferFrom,(from,address(this),amount))) (reclaim/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV1.sol#99)
		- (ok,result) = rewardToken.call(data) (reclaim/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV1.sol#108)
	Balance read before the call:
	- b = IReclaimERC20(rewardToken).balanceOf(from) (reclaim/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV1.sol#98)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- IReclaimERC20(rewardToken).balanceOf(address(this)) != a + amount || IReclaimERC20(rewardToken).balanceOf(from) + amount != b (reclaim/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV1.sol#100)
		- stale variable `b`
findings.stateTransition: funded/reserve effects are recorded before guarded transferFrom; all state rolls back on failure
findings.potentialReentry: Token low-level call can attempt a callback; V1 nonReentrant and exact deltas remain intact. Its return path is rejected historical behavior, not an approved product
findings.invariant: Actual standard-token balance deltas, permanent retirement/supply/ownership evidence and atomic rollback; invariantEveryPaidRewardHasPermanentRetirementAndConservedBacking
findings.assumptions: Production must bind the actual independently reviewed fixed-supply TokenV2 runtime; a malicious token can lie about balances and is not admitted by the canonical fixture profile
findings.uncertainty: Passing finite tests is not a proof for every external token/collection or future chain state. Strict analysis remains failed and independent disposition is not claimed.

findings.description:
Reentrancy in RMTReclaimCampaignV2._sink721(address,uint256,uint64) (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#244-251):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- IReclaimV2ERC721(asset).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender,permanentSink,id,abi.encode(receiptId)) (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#247)
	Balance read before the call:
	- fromBalance = IReclaimV2ERC721(asset).balanceOf(msg.sender) (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#246)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- IReclaimV2ERC721(asset).ownerOf(id) != permanentSink || IReclaimV2ERC721(asset).balanceOf(permanentSink) != sinkBalance + 1 || IReclaimV2ERC721(asset).balanceOf(msg.sender) + 1 != fromBalance || afterSupply != beforeSupply (reclaim-v2/src/RMTReclaimCampaignV2.sol#249-250)
		- stale variable `fromBalance`

findings.invariant: Actual standard-token balance deltas, permanent retirement/supply/ownership evidence and atomic rollback; invariantEveryPaidRewardHasPermanentRetirementAndConservedBacking
findings.assumptions: Only reviewed non-upgradeable, non-seizable, mint-once collection runtimes and the exact immutable contract sink are admitted; unknown issuer powers remain unsupported
findings.uncertainty: Passing finite tests is not a proof for every external token/collection or future chain state. Strict analysis remains failed and independent disposition is not claimed.

changes.effect: Typed transfer/transferFrom require true, rejecting previously permissive empty return data; exact two-sided balance checks and guard stay intact
changes.clearance: None: four token balance warnings remain

changes.kind: Separate native and sink 721 settlement functions
changes.effect: Removes invalid cross-branch burn-to-sinkBalance dataflow and makes the two retirement mechanisms independently reviewable; every original balance/supply/ownership check retained
changes.clearance: Not zero: final seven high observations remain and total findings increased from initial44 to final45

coverageLimits: Every production root and reachable import is parsed, with all101detectors. Lack of findings for ERC1155 array-held balance/supply baselines is not proof of complete precision.
Assembly CREATE2/data-part code retrieval requires source and bytecode identity review in addition to static analysis.
NFT issuer/upgrade/remint rights cannot be universally inferred from ERC165 or runtime code hash alone; no real collection is admitted.
Historical core V1/V2 funding-parser gaps,22core/dependencyhighs and6TreasuryV1highs remain separately unresolved.

sizes.codePartNote: The compiler-reported57-byte unreachable deployed template is NOT the actual data runtime. Actual parts are STOP plus each exact half of the23676-byte campaign creation code, reconstructed and hash-checked.
